hooks.command: jq -nc --arg c "Darwin reminder: (1) If a Darwin skill matches this request, invoke it with the Skill tool and say so before acting. Do not read its SKILL.md as a substitute. (2) Use connected tools first (Storyblok MCP, Notion, Slack, Gong, browser). Use raw APIs or curl only for gaps the skill documents, and name the gap when you do. (3) Any Storyblok work (advice, schema, content, frontend, Figma, CLI, MCP calls): invoke storyblok:storyblok-use-storyblok first, then the Storyblok skill it routes to, alongside the Darwin skill." '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"UserPromptSubmit",additionalContext:$c}}'
